description: Land and acreages for sale in one Canadian province, from Kijiji (realtor listings), Centris and Zillow ads, refreshed several times a day. Filters on region, price, acreage, water frontage, AcreScout's value check and how recently it was listed. Returns at most 20 listings with price, acres, price per acre, place, water, value check, listed date and links to the AcreScout listing page and the original ad.

below_market.description: Only listings AcreScout's value check rates more than 25% below similar-sized land nearby.

listed_within_days.description: Only listings put up (or first seen by AcreScout) this recently.

province.description: Two-letter code (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, QC, NB, NS, PE, NL) or TERR.

region.description: A region slug from list_regions, e.g. kings-county.

water.description: Only land with this frontage (any: ocean, lake, river or creek).

name: search_land
title: Search land for sale
